payload.rationale: For Cadmium at Outfall 001, the packet positively shows that every mass-limit column (30-day average, daily max, 7-day average) and every concentration-limit column except 7-day average are marked N/A, while the 7-day average concentration cell requires Report rather than a numeric value; measurement is specified at 1/Quarter with Grab sampling. The same table structure, with identical column headers, expresses enforceable numeric limits for other pollutants (e.g., Cyanide at 14.67 ug/L and 22 ug/L). Section A introductory language ties discharge authorization to limits and monitoring as specified in this table. This is establishing evidence—not inference from blank cells—that the Cadmium row establishes monitoring and reporting obligations without an enforceable numeric effluent limitation for any stated averaging period. REJECT would require grounded evidence of a numeric limit, which the packet does not contain.
